answer_1.quote: We evaluate 24 state-of-the-art LMMs ... on VideoVista-CulturalLingo benchmark.

answer_2.quote: Experimental results show that Gemini-2.0-Flash demonstrates the strongest performance among all models, achieving an accuracy score of 76.3%.

answer_3.quote: All candidate questions are first filtered linguistically using Qwen2.5-7B with the CircularEval strategy to remove any video-agnostic items.

answer_4.quote: Human annotators then select the high-quality questions from generated QA pairs and further refine them to enhance clarity and quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess each question for correctness, type relevance, and video relevance, and revise low‑scoring items.
